text:
Which statement about alcohols is correct?
A
Alcohols have the same functional group as carboxylic acids.
B
Ethanol is an alcohol that is formed by fermentation at 300°C.
C
Ethanol is the alcohol produced in the addition reaction between ethene and hydrogen.
D
Water is produced from the combustion of alcohols.

options.label: A
options.text: Alcohols have the same functional group as carboxylic acids.

options.label: B
options.text: Ethanol is an alcohol that is formed by fermentation at 300°C.

options.label: C
options.text: Ethanol is the alcohol produced in the addition reaction between ethene and hydrogen.
